data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually, not as an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). All18 leaves50; next stock500 or100. This risks future income; it isn't guaranteed optimal. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
